meta.name: sprint-manager
meta.description: Solo dev sprint planning and task management with Plane. Use when planning sprints, sizing tasks, managing the backlog, or structuring work for ADHD productivity patterns. Not Agile — solo dev workflow.

copy.tagline: 把零散任务理成可执行的冲刺计划
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你是独立开发者,想把杂乱任务整理成清晰的冲刺计划。
copy.tagline_en: Turn scattered tasks into an actionable sprint plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're a solo dev who wants to structure messy tasks into clear sprint plans.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按单人 sprint 流程帮你管理任务:创建任务时默认拆成小任务并补上“完成定义”,规划时核算容量并搭配能量标签,中途加需求会要求一进一出,回顾时反馈完成情况。
howto.when: 当你提出要规划 sprint、给任务估大小(如 S/M/L)、清理 backlog,或想按 ADHD 友好的节奏安排工作时,Claude 会进入这套流程。

say.text: 帮我计划这周的 sprint,从 backlog 里挑三个任务。
say.note: Claude 会按容量和能量搭配给出建议。

say.text: 这个“实现玩家移动”太大,帮我拆成 S 和 M 任务。
say.note: Claude 会拆出可执行的小任务并写完成定义。

say.text: 中途想加个新功能到 sprint,怎么办?
say.note: Claude 会要求用新任务换一个现有任务,不直接加。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude will manage tasks in a solo-sprint style: it defaults to small tickets with a concrete "done" definition, checks capacity and energy mix when planning, requires a swap when adding mid-sprint, and gives review feedback.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to plan a sprint, size tasks (S/M/L), groom the backlog, or structure work around ADHD-friendly patterns.

say_en.text: Plan this week's sprint and pick three tasks from the backlog.
say_en.note: Claude will suggest based on capacity and energy mix.

say_en.text: This 'implement player movement' is too big; break it into S and M tasks.
say_en.note: Claude will split it and add done criteria.

say_en.text: I want to add a feature mid-sprint; what should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will require swapping one task in for another.
